query:
INSERT INTO thread (board_id, subject, author_id, created_at, last_post_at)
               SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
               WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board WHERE id = ?)
                 AND (? IS NULL
                      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM post WHERE author_id = ? AND created_at >= ?) < ?)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
